career_ladder.note: Sub-Inspectors (Unarmed Branch) and Sergeants in Kolkata Police hold executive field command across city police stations, the Detective Department, Special Branch, and Traffic Police departments. Promotion channels are governed by Kolkata Police service regulations, Kolkata Police Act, and the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019).

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the posts of Sub-Inspector/Sub-Inspectress (Unarmed Branch) and Sergeant in Kolkata Police is conducted by the West Bengal Police Recruitment Board (WBPRB). The examination pattern consists of: (i) Preliminary Examination (Screening, 200 marks), (ii) Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET), (iii) Final Combined Competitive Examination (Conventional Descriptive, 200 marks), and (iv) Personality Test (Interview, 30 marks with minimum 8 marks qualifying). Final merit is compiled strictly on the aggregate score of the Final Combined Competitive Examination and the Personality Test (Total: 230 marks).

financial_package.note: Kolkata Police Sub-Inspectors and Sergeants are appointed under Pay Level 10 of the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019), corresponding to pre-revised Pay Band-3 (₹7,100 – ₹37,600 with Grade Pay ₹3,900). Entry basic pay is ₹32,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019, Level 10, and WBPRB Kolkata Police Recruitment Notification
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on ROPA 2019 Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹32,100 with project constant 58% Dearness Allowance (₹18,618), 12% House Rent Allowance (₹3,852), Medical Allowance (₹500/month), plus Kolkata Police metropolitan mobility and urban policing allowances. Deductions include West Bengal Professional Tax (PTax ₹200) and GPF/NPS contributions (~10% basic+DA).
official_perks: Kolkata Police executive family residential quarters or 12% House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Coverage under the West Bengal Health Scheme (WBHS) for officer and eligible family members
Official motorcycle / mobility and fuel allowance for urban investigative and traffic enforcement duty
Annual uniform allowance, kit replacement grant, and accoutrement maintenance
Metropolitan compensatory duty allowances during major festivals, sports championships, and VIP visits
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and leave encashment under West Bengal Service Rules

competition_benchmarks.note: Kolkata Police Sub-Inspector and Sergeant recruitment is administered by WBPRB for metropolitan policing. Vacancies are verified directly from WBPRB official employment notifications. Applicant counts are reported from administrative briefing statistics.
